name: Aleph-One-PsVita
description: A PSVita Port of Aleph One
long_description: This is a native port of Aleph One for the PS Vita. Aleph One is the open source engine behind Bungie's *Marathon*, *Marathon 2: Durandal* and *Marathon Infinity*, and it also runs a huge library of fan made scenarios like *Eternal*, *Rubicon X* or *Marathon Phoenix*.
